ato.name: Avatar Texture Optimizer
ato.inspector.help: Beginner: keep the defaults and click VRChat Build / NDMF Bake. Advanced options are folded below. This tool only changes mesh UVs and texture references — never other material parameters.
ato.inspector.generateAtlas.tooltip: On: pack UV islands into atlases. Off: scale whole textures, do not crop unused UV or rewrite UVs.
ato.inspector.npot.tooltip: Use 64px steps instead of powers of two. PVRTC and other NPOT-incompatible formats are removed from the enum.
ato.inspector.preset.tooltip: Near Lossless skips UV scaling. Custom is never overwritten by other presets (defaults all 1).
ato.inspector.whitelist.help: Meshes, materials, textures, animation clips — anything. Every Texture2D referenced by these objects is fully skipped. Other textures that share the same UV skip atlasing only.
ato.inspector.platform.help: Unchecked: use the built-in best defaults for the current build target. Check a platform to show its format / mip options.
ato.inspector.missingDescriptor: This component must be on the same object as VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ato.inspector.duplicate: Only one Avatar Texture Optimizer is allowed on an avatar (including children). Extra components will abort the bake.
ato.progress.title: Avatar Texture Optimizer
ato.error.noDescriptor: Avatar Texture Optimizer must be on an object with VRCAvatarDescriptor. Bake aborted.
ato.error.duplicate: More than one Avatar Texture Optimizer was found on this avatar. Bake aborted.
ato.warn.uvWrap: Texture '{0}' has UV islands that cross the wrap seam or cannot be normalized into [0,1]. Treated as whitelist.
ato.warn.shaderUnknown: Shader '{0}' on '{1}' could not be fully analyzed. Related textures treated as whitelist.
ato.warn.atlasOverflow: UV group for texture '{0}' does not fit the max atlas. Atlasing skipped for that UV group.
ato.warn.grayFallback: Grayscale format was requested but the texture uses multiple channels. Saved as multi-channel and warned.
ato.warn.alphaFallback: A texture with alpha cannot use an opaque compression format. Fell back to a safe format.
ato.warn.pvrtcNpot: PVRTC is not available when NPOT atlases are enabled.
ato.report.title: ATO build report
ato.report.summary: Textures {0} → {1}, atlases {2}, islands {3}, estimated VRAM {4} → {5} ({6:0.0}% saved)
